articles.headline: Senne Lammens mistake sends Spain into World Cup semifinal at Belgium's expense
articles.description: Mikel Merino scored in the 88th minute on a rebound yielded by backup Belgium goalkeeper Senne Lammens, and Spain advanced to the World Cup semifinals with a 2-1 victory on Friday.
